descriptors.concept_name: Lesser Penalties For One Person Companies Or Small Companies [Section 446B]
descriptors.definition: Certain entities like One Person Companies, small companies, start-up companies, and Producer Companies face reduced penalties for non-compliance under the Act. The imposed penalty cannot exceed half of the specified amount, subject to a maximum cap of two lakh rupees for the company and one lakh rupees for an officer in default or other person.
exclusion: Normal public or private companies not falling under the specified categories
nearby_distinctions: Distinct from standard penalties under general provisions, applying specifically capped reduced rates to designated corporate structures.

descriptors.definition: The Central Government appoints officers not below the rank of Registrar as adjudicating officers to determine penalties for non-compliance under the Act. These officers must issue a written show cause notice allowing fifteen to thirty days for an electronic reply before adjudging any penalty.
instrument_references: Rule 3 of the Companies (Adjudication of Penalties) Rules, 2014
inclusion: appointment of officers not below the rank of Registrar
exclusion: judicial court trials for offenses subjected to administrative adjudication by designated officers
nearby_distinctions: Distinguishes administrative penalty adjudication by executive officers from judicial proceedings handled by special courts.

descriptors.definition: When a company, officer, or person commits the same default again within three years of a previous penalty order, they face an increased penalty for the subsequent default. The penalty amount for such repeated non-compliance equals twice the amount originally specified under the relevant provision.
inclusion: second or subsequent default committed within three years of a prior penalty order
exclusion: first-time defaults or offenses occurring after the three-year window
nearby_distinctions: Differs from standard single-instance penalties by applying an escalated multiplier specifically for recidivism within a defined temporal window.
